规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• keep spacing aligned to the detected 12px rhythm.
• reuse the Elevated surface treatment consistently across cards and controls.
• keep corner radii within the detected 2px, 9999px family.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。
• 没有明确理由时，不要超过检测到的极简动效强度。
动效
动效保持克制，以界面为主导，覆盖文字、布局与滚动过渡。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。

WebGL
WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a centered hero field using canvas-backed effect. The effect should read as technical, meditative, and atmospheric: dot-matrix particle field with lime on cyan and sparse spacing. Build it from dot particles + soft depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve dom fallback.
